import re
paths = list_files('reports/q2')
total = 0
for p in paths:
    text = read_file(p)
    lines = [l for l in text.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()]
    last = lines[-1]
    m = re.search(r'TOTAL:\s*([-\d.]+)', last)
    if m:
        total += float(m.group(1))
    else:
        print('NO TOTAL in', p, repr(last))
print(total)
